ThingDef.label: combat uplink node I
ThingDef.description: A basic auxiliary uplink that transmits combat enhancement data to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Slightly increases melee damage, ranged accuracy, and movement speed while powered.

ThingDef.label: combat uplink node II
ThingDef.description: An enhanced auxiliary uplink that transmits a higher-bandwidth combat signal to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Meaningfully increases melee damage, ranged accuracy, and movement speed while powered.

ThingDef.label: combat uplink node III
ThingDef.description: A pinnacle combat auxiliary node transmitting a full-spectrum enhancement signal to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Dramatically increases melee damage, ranged accuracy, and movement speed while powered.

ThingDef.label: work protocol node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads basic expanded behavioral protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells, unlocking crafting and basic construction work that lower-tier avatars normally cannot perform.

ThingDef.label: work protocol node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads comprehensive behavioral protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells, unlocking hunting, medical, and artistic work in addition to all Tier I work types.

ThingDef.label: core optimizer node I
ThingDef.description: A maintenance uplink that services any synthera altar within 5 cells. Reduces respawn and recreate cooldowns by 20% and gently counters system stress accumulation while powered.

ThingDef.label: core optimizer node II
ThingDef.description: An advanced maintenance uplink that services any synthera altar within 5 cells. Halves all respawn and recreate cooldowns and actively reduces system stress accumulation while powered.

ThingDef.label: core optimizer node III
ThingDef.description: A pinnacle maintenance uplink that services any synthera altar within 5 cells. Near-zero cooldowns and continuous active stress purging keep the avatar at peak efficiency indefinitely while powered.

ThingDef.label: soldier role node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads basic combat behavioral protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Slightly boosts melee damage and ranged performance.

ThingDef.label: soldier role node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads advanced combat protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Significantly boosts melee damage, ranged cooldown, and aiming speed.

ThingDef.label: soldier role node III
ThingDef.description: Uploads a full combat behavioral matrix rewrite to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Dramatically enhances all offensive parameters including movement speed.

ThingDef.label: worker role node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads basic labor protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Slightly boosts global work speed, construction, and mining efficiency.

ThingDef.label: worker role node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads advanced labor protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Significantly boosts global work speed, construction, and mining efficiency.

ThingDef.label: worker role node III
ThingDef.description: Uploads a full labor matrix rewrite to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Greatly enhances work speed, construction, mining, and plant work efficiency.

ThingDef.label: medic role node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads basic medical protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Slightly improves tending quality, operation speed, and surgery success chance.

ThingDef.label: medic role node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads advanced medical protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Significantly improves tending quality, operation speed, and surgery success chance.

ThingDef.label: medic role node III
ThingDef.description: Uploads a full medical matrix rewrite to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Greatly enhances tending, surgery success, and operation speed.

ThingDef.label: scout role node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads basic mobility and social protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Slightly improves movement speed, social impact, and trade prices.

ThingDef.label: scout role node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads advanced mobility and social protocols to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Significantly improves movement speed, social impact, and trade prices.

ThingDef.label: scout role node III
ThingDef.description: Uploads a full mobility and social matrix rewrite to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Greatly enhances movement, social impact, and trade efficiency.

ThingDef.label: armor matrix node I
ThingDef.description: Projects a basic reinforcement lattice onto any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Reduces all incoming damage by 15% while powered.

ThingDef.label: armor matrix node II
ThingDef.description: Projects a dense reinforcement lattice onto any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Reduces all incoming damage by 30% while powered.

ThingDef.label: armor matrix node III
ThingDef.description: Projects a maximum-density reinforcement lattice onto any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Reduces all incoming damage by 50% while powered. The avatar becomes extraordinarily difficult to destroy.

ThingDef.label: overclock core node I
ThingDef.description: Pushes a nearby avatar's combat systems past safe operational limits. Dramatically enhances melee, ranged, and mobility — but system stress accumulates twice as fast. Recall the avatar more frequently or risk critical failure.

ThingDef.label: overclock core node II
ThingDef.description: Extreme overclock. The avatar's combat output is extraordinary but system stress accumulates three times faster than normal. Deployment windows are short — plan accordingly.

ThingDef.label: overclock core node III
ThingDef.description: Maximum theoretical overclock. Combat performance borders on the impossible. System stress accumulates five times faster — the avatar can sustain less than four hours of deployment before reaching critical stress. A devastating but fragile weapon.

ThingDef.label: versatility protocol node I
ThingDef.description: Uploads broad behavioral enhancements to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Improves research speed, carry capacity, plant work, and hunting stealth while powered.

ThingDef.label: versatility protocol node II
ThingDef.description: Uploads a deep-spectrum behavioral imprint to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Dramatically improves research, carrying, plant work, stealth, and social skills while powered. The avatar approaches universal competency.

ThingDef.label: combat uplink node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech combat uplink node assembled from recovered shard fragments. It transmits a combat enhancement signal of theoretically impossible density to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Melee, ranged, and movement performance are pushed far beyond any known limit. As a side effect of its archotech power regulation, the node generates a small amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: work protocol node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech work protocol node that uploads every behavioral work package simultaneously to any synthera avatar within 5 cells. The avatar gains access to every possible work type with no remaining restrictions. The node generates a small amount of electricity as a side effect of its operation.

ThingDef.label: core optimizer node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech maintenance uplink that reduces all avatar respawn and recreate cooldowns to near-zero and continuously purges system stress at a rate that negates even overclock-level accumulation. With this node active, the avatar requires almost no downtime. The node also generates a modest amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: armor matrix node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech armor matrix node that projects a maximum-density reinforcement lattice onto any synthera avatar within 5 cells. Incoming damage is reduced by 85%. The avatar becomes effectively unkillable by conventional weapons. The lattice generates a small amount of electricity as a side effect.

ThingDef.label: overclock core node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech overclock node that pushes the avatar's systems into an operational regime that should be physically impossible. Combat performance is barely describable. System stress accumulates ten times faster than normal — every deployment must be treated as a timed strike mission. The node generates a small amount of electricity, though this feels almost like mockery given what it demands in return.

ThingDef.label: versatility protocol node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech versatility node that uploads a deep behavioral enhancement package to any synthera avatar within 5 cells, covering every non-combat capability simultaneously at maximum possible intensity. Research, labor, social interactions, and field work all reach superhuman levels. The node generates a modest amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: soldier role node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech role node that rewrites the avatar's core behavioral matrix as a dedicated combat unit. Offensive performance reaches levels no known technology can reproduce. The node generates a small amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: worker role node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech role node that rewrites the avatar's core behavioral matrix as a dedicated labor unit. Work and construction proceed at a pace that makes biological colonists appear stationary. The node generates a small amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: medic role node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech role node that rewrites the avatar's core behavioral matrix as a dedicated medical unit. Surgical outcomes approach certainty and tending quality far exceeds any biological physician. The node generates a small amount of electricity.

ThingDef.label: scout role node archotech
ThingDef.description: An archotech role node that rewrites the avatar's core behavioral matrix as a dedicated mobility and social unit. Movement speed and social manipulation capabilities reach levels no biological entity can match. The node generates a small amount of electricity.
